description: Syria: Infrastructure Maps (Power line / Water Way Dam /Highway) is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Syria. Eight spatial layer of Syria power line and generator and power plant and substation. Two spatial layer of Syria Natural Water and waterway dam. Four spatial layer of Syria highway /motorway / link /primary / trunk. Coverage: Syrian Arab Republic. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Syria. Its tags are facilities-infrastructure, geodata. It offers 3 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-04-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
